verification_notes.note: Corrected EBITDA and EBT guidance percentage ranges to reflect actual year-over-year changes: EBITDA guidance of DKK 28-36m corresponds to -10% to +16% vs 2025 actual, not -10% to -16%; EBT guidance of DKK 18-24m corresponds to approximately -5% to +26% vs 2025 actual, not -12% to -17%.

redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. Each unit addresses distinct material facts: revenue growth (K1), Q4 performance (K2), IAA optimization (K3), Big 3 contribution (K4), Farm Manager launch (K5), 2026 guidance (K6), financial position (K7), strategic pipeline (K8), share buy-back (K9). No substantial overlap exists.

key_information_units.information: Record revenue growth of 40% to DKK 126.5m (2024: DKK 90.1m) driven by scaling of the Transport Series, with EBITDA up 26% to DKK 31.1m and EBT surging 109% to DKK 19.0m.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Highlights & Key Ratios table and Financial Performance section detailing year-over-year growth metrics.

key_information_units.information: Q4 2025 was the strongest quarter in company history with revenue of DKK 40.96m (+106% QoQ), led by Farm Manager (DKK 11.7m), Truck Manager (DKK 8.99m), and Airline Manager (DKK 10.25m).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Q4 Financial Performance section showing quarterly revenue breakdown and growth rates.

key_information_units.information: In-App Advertising (IAA) revenue doubled to DKK 18.48m (2024: DKK 9.23m) following strategic optimization initiatives initiated in late September 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenue Mix Expansion section detailing IAA growth and optimization timeline.

key_information_units.information: The 'Big 3' titles (Airline Manager, Truck Manager, Farm Manager) generated 67% of 2025 revenue (DKK 85m) and 65% of EBITDA, up from 35% revenue and 25% EBITDA in 2024.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Progress & Results section analyzing title-specific revenue contributions.

key_information_units.information: Farm Manager launched in July 2025 with 5 million pre-registrations, contributing DKK 22.0m in its first six months and becoming a top-grossing title.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Farm Manager section in Portfolio Overview detailing launch metrics and revenue.

key_information_units.information: 2026 guidance targets revenue of DKK 130-153m (+3% to +21%), EBITDA of DKK 28-36m (-10% to +16%), and EBT of DKK 18-24m (-5% to +26%), contingent on marketing efficiency and monetization scaling.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Outlook 2026 section providing full-year financial targets and key assumptions.

key_information_units.information: Robust financial position with 78% solvency ratio, total equity of DKK 66.1m, and zero interest-bearing debt; cash position improved to DKK 36.4m by 31 January 2026 after year-end adjustments.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Performance section on capital structure and Liquidity dynamics.

key_information_units.information: Strategic pipeline includes Train Manager 2 (flagship release) and Space Manager (galactic-scale exploration), with four major projects planned for the 2027+ horizon.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Outlook 2026 and Milestones in 2025 sections outlining product roadmap.

key_information_units.information: Completion of DKK 5m share buy-back program repurchasing 458,572 shares at an average price of DKK 10.89, holding 3.87% treasury shares as of 31 December 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Share buy-back program details in Financial Review and Shareholder Information.
